ocl.definition: user:User = User.allInstance()->any(u | u.UserID = uid), bookSet:Set(Book) = Book.allInstance()->select(b | b.CallNo = callNo), hasBook:Boolean = if bookSet.isEmpty() then false else true endif, recommend:RecommendBook, isCreated:Boolean = if user.oclIsUndefined() then false else true endif
ocl.precondition: not user.oclIsUndefined() and user.BorrowStatus = User::NORMAL and bookSet.isEmpty()
ocl.postcondition: let recommend:RecommendBook in recommend.oclIsNew() and RecommendBook.allInstance()->includes(recommend) and recommend.RecommendUser = user and recommend.RecommendDate = self.SystemDate and user.RecommendedBook->includes(recommend) and result = (isCreated and not hasBook)
